data_objects.name: daily_asset_market_history
data_objects.meaning: Daily market history for an asset, with open-high-low-close prices, trading volume, and market capitalization.
data_objects.notes: The asset identity, currency, venue, and definitions of volume and market capitalization are not included.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Calendar date of the market record, written as abbreviated month, day, and year.

variables.name: Volume
variables.meaning: Trading volume for the date, stored with comma group separators.

variables.name: Market Cap
variables.meaning: Market capitalization associated with the asset and date, stored with comma group separators.

structure.description: Each row is one daily asset-market record identified by Date; rows are arranged in reverse chronological order.
Open, High, Low, and Close summarize prices for the same date, while Volume and Market Cap describe activity and valuation.

uncertainties: The asset, currency denomination, market venue, time zone, and whether dates are calendar or trading dates are not stated.
The units represented by Volume and Market Cap are not recoverable from train.csv.
annotation_notes: No asset or currency is inferred beyond the market terminology present in the source columns.
